youtube_description:
Here is the raw uncut footage from my encounter with this creature/thing..idk. 
If you watch the video multiple times you'll notice it's far from something like a deer and way too big to be anything smaller like a fox etc.

Let me know what you think about this footage in the comments. I've showed some other forest experts this evidence and all of them have said I'm lucky to be alive, and even more lucky to have gotten this experience all on film. 
Most encounters usually go undocumented, or if they are, it's usually just "trust me bro" or "I'm not kidding" stories without any photographic or any evidence.
